objective: Single promotion pipeline for JNU information modules and executable trading strategies.

stages.interpretation: This can promote only to INFORMATION_STATE_CANDIDATE, never directly to validated trading alpha.

examples: HAR-RSV: OSE mini 2006+ then Micro 2023+ consistency
Intraday-path hypotheses: true JNU/OSE minute data
pass_requires: Frozen proxy specification reused without rescue
True target-market data integrity gate passes
stages.interpretation: Proxy PASS is insufficient without this stage when target data was not used.

pass_requires: Exact mapping from information state to positions preregistered
No additional indicator voting introduced opportunistically

stages.pass_means: Signal/position/order/fill/cost implementation reproduces the published causal rule.

stages.historical_warning: Both volatility_regime and cross_market_confirmation passed independent replay but failed this stage.

pass_requires: No reliance on unavailable fill prices

stages.preferred: New forward data or genuinely untouched holdout

stages.rule: Only after all applicable earlier stages pass may a module influence live JNU decision probabilities as validated evidence.

role_rules.risk_state: May affect size/stops/confidence after its applicable evidence gates; does not imply direction.
role_rules.event_state: May affect confidence/no-trade/volatility expectation; direction requires separate family.
role_rules.source_weighting: May weight contemporaneous market information; cannot be counted as an independent directional vote without alpha validation.
role_rules.execution_state: May improve entry/exit/invalidation; not an independent alpha by default.
